Epic.label: WorkItemId
Epic.description: Unique identifier of the work item.

Epic.label: Title
Epic.description: Short descriptive title of the work item.

Epic.label: Description
Epic.description: Detailed description of the work item.

Epic.label: State
Epic.description: Current workflow state.

Epic.label: Tags
Epic.description: Semicolon-separated list of tags.

Epic.label: Assigned To
Epic.description: Person to whom the work item is assigned.

Epic.label: Area Path
Epic.description: Area classification for the work item.

Epic.label: Iteration Path
Epic.description: Iteration (sprint) the work item belongs to.

Epic.label: Priority
Epic.description: Priority of the work item (1=highest, 4=lowest).

Epic.label: Business Value
Epic.description: Numeric value indicating business importance.

Epic.label: Risk
Epic.description: Risk level: 1-High, 2-Medium, 3-Low.

Epic.label: Value Area
Epic.description: Type of value delivered (e.g. Business or Architectural).

Epic.label: Time Criticality
Epic.description: Measure of how time-critical this work item is.

Epic.label: Effort
Epic.description: Effort estimate in story points or hours.

Epic.label: Start Date
Epic.description: Planned start date for the work item.

Epic.label: Target Date
Epic.description: Planned target/end date for the work item.

Epic.label: Reason
Epic.description: The reason why the bug is in the current state

Epic.label: History
Epic.description: Discussion thread plus automatic record of changes

Epic.label: Resolved Reason
Epic.description: The reason why the bug was resolved

Epic.label: Stack Rank
Epic.description: Work first on items with lower-valued stack rank. Set in triage.

Epic.label: Integration Build
Epic.description: The build in which the bug was fixed
